result.summary: The page is largely functional, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel is visually broken: its cards have inconsistent image heights, vertical offsets and baselines, one card has a near-white image background that makes its badge unreadable, and the third card's title is clipped at the screen edge. Favorite icons in 'Popular right now' are styled inconsistently, and the second popular card is cut off by the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are not aligned to a common baseline — the Green Bowl Poké image is shorter and sits higher, Smash Bros Burgers is pushed lower, so titles and delivery prices appear at three different vertical positions.
issues.suggestion: Enforce a fixed image aspect ratio/height and align all carousel items to the top of a shared row container so titles and metadata line up.

issues.description: The '15–25 min' badge on the Green Bowl Poké card is white text/pill on a very light image background, giving very poor contrast compared to the same badge on the darker cards.
issues.suggestion: Add a consistent dark scrim or solid dark badge background behind the ETA text, or force a dark text style when the underlying image is light.

issues.description: The third carousel card's title 'Trattoria Piccol…' is hard-clipped by the screen edge with no ellipsis or peek affordance, and its image bleeds off-screen inconsistently with the other cards.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent horizontal padding/peek width for the carousel and truncate long titles with an ellipsis within the card bounds.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) icons are styled inconsistently in 'Popular right now': the first card's heart has no background circle while the second card's heart sits on a dark circular backdrop.
issues.suggestion: Use one heart button treatment (e.g. always a semi-transparent circular backdrop) across all cards.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar, hiding its name and details with no visual hint that more content follows.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the nav bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped mid-chip at the right edge, so the partially visible filter is unreadable and gives a broken rather than scrollable impression.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek so a meaningful portion of the next chip shows, or add a fade/gradient edge to signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: 'Fastest near you' cards show only ETA and delivery fee, while 'Popular right now' cards show rating, cuisine and ETA, making the two sections feel inconsistent and leaving the top cards information-poor.
issues.suggestion: Standardize card metadata (rating, ETA, delivery fee) across both sections.
